newsitem.title: GERMANY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF DOWNHILL WINNER ALPHAND.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF DOWNHILL WINNER ALPHAND.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of the ninth men's World Cup downhill of the Alpine skiing season on Saturday:

World Cup wins: 12. Downhills - Garmisch-Partenkirchen (97) Kitzbuehel (97), Bormio (97), Val Gardena (97), Garmisch-Partenkirchen (96), Kitzbuehel I and II (95), Bormio (95), Vail (95), Val d'Isere (95). Super-Gs - Laax (97), Garmisch- Partenkirchen (97)

Other notable achievements: World Cup downhill champion 1995 and 1996. Downhill bronze medallist at the 1996 world championships in Sierra Nevada, Spain. Career disrupted by serious injuries, list of which is nearly as long as his triumphs. After tearing knee ligaments at Whistler in 1993 he seriously considered retiring but is now serious contender to become first Frenchman to win overall World Cup title since Jean-Claude Killy in 1968. Enjoys hunting, rally driving and moto-cross.
